subject: [PATCH v2 6/8] selftests/nfsd: factor the netlink plumbing into a shared header

2026-09-22.patch_summary: This patch extracts the netlink plumbing code from nfsd_netlink_listener.c into a shared header file, nfsd_netlink.h. The shared header contains static inline functions that handle generic-netlink client setup, attribute packing, extack parsing, and family resolution. This allows other NFS selftests to reuse this common functionality without having to duplicate the code or link against it.
